share_numpy_array_locally: create a memory-shared numpy array across local processes using multiprocessing shared memory
SharedList_init: create a SharedList that serializes a list of objects into shared memory for cross-process access
SharedList_getitem: retrieve a deserialized object from a SharedList by index using shared memory buffers
SharedList_setitem: update an item in a SharedList with same-size pickled data when inplace updates are allowed
SharedList_len: get the number of elements stored in a SharedList backed by shared memory
